nvidia-spy-probe.title: The scandal surrounding Nvidia’s former chief deepens: a personal affair, espionage and pressure on the AI market
nvidia-spy-probe.summary: Media outlets are reporting on the scandal surrounding former Nvidia chief Jensen Huang: he is accused of hiding personal relationships and misleading the company’s lawyers amid investigations into ties with a Chinese entrepreneur and the firm Megaspeed. According to several publications, the story is already affecting debate over Nvidia’s future, intensifying talk of risks for the AI market and of possible pressure on U.S.-China talks on AI safety. The outlets also link the case to political fallout in the United States and tensions surrounding relations between Washington and Beijing. Some reports, meanwhile, reduce the matter to the broader tale of Huang’s “fall” and its consequences for Silicon Valley.
nvidia-spy-probe.picture: The image shows a fallen chip crown wrapped in a web of cables, with a masked spy, scattered contracts and broken gold coins nearby. It is an image of lost power, hidden manipulation, and a blow to money and influence around AI.

ukraine-peace-framework.title: The U.S., Europe, Ukraine and Russia prepare a new round of talks with no breakthrough
ukraine-peace-framework.summary: The U.S., Europe, Ukraine and Russia are preparing a new round of talks on ending the war, but there are no signs of a breakthrough. The New York Times and other outlets write that after the latest round of discussions in Abu Dhabi, Kyiv said the issue of territorial concessions in exchange for NATO membership was raised for the first time, but Ukraine does not agree to that. Ukrainian and Western reports also say Moscow is putting forward demands to the West, including a pullback of NATO troops to the 1997 borders, and that this is drawing skepticism from some U.S. senators. Separate reports say a trilateral meeting of Trump, Putin and Xi is planned in China.

brooklyn-building-collapse.summary: In New Orleans, a tanker collided with a cruise vessel on the Mississippi, after which passengers had to be rescued. The company said the incident was caused by network or server-infrastructure problems; some reports also link it to a network update. The Gulf Cooperation Council is warning of the risk of a food crisis because of disruptions to fertilizer and ammonia shipments. The outlets agree that the situation in the strait remains dangerous and is affecting global markets.

pope-peru-homecoming.title: Pope Leo XIV returns warmly to Peru, where he is welcomed as one of their own
pope-peru-homecoming.summary: Pope Leo XIV has returned to Peru and was warmly welcomed in Chiclayo, the city where he once served as bishop. The French press says nearly one million people came to the city, while other outlets say 1.5 million attended the mass and the reception. The pontiff himself called the return a “joy” and thanked God; for local residents, it feels like coming “home.” Reports differ only in their estimate of the crowd size, but they agree on the main point: the welcome was deeply emotional.

uk-eu-security-powers.summary: European countries are strengthening intelligence services and security measures amid threats from Russia and hybrid attacks. Separate reporting covers the reaction of U.S. military personnel to suspicious drone activity over a base in Britain. faa-groundstop.title: All departures in the United States were halted for several hours because of a failure in the air-traffic communications system
faa-groundstop.summary: All departures in the United States were halted for several hours because of a failure in the air-traffic communications system. The FAA declared a nationwide ground stop, which it then lifted, but chaos at airports continued: thousands of flights were canceled or delayed, and passengers were stranded across the country. Authorities blamed the incident on overloaded legacy systems or a technical failure, not a cyberattack. It is one of the most serious aviation disruptions in the United States in recent years.

starship-flight-15-orbit-breakthrough.summary: SpaceX sent Starship into orbit for the first time during its 15th test flight, but the attempt to catch the booster ended in failure. The main achievement was the orbital flight, while the main setback was the loss of the booster.
